decisions.text: type bar: not every part of the total is shown: a regular bar chart (G0.13)
nominal categories sorted by value, descending
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart: vertical bars
3 values against 5 scale labels: whichever puts fewer numbers on the chart (G2.18): the values labelled directly, the value scale and its gridlines removed, the zero line kept as the baseline
value labels as a set, one magnitude and one number of decimals, the prefix and suffix on each: $375K, $348K, $200K (G6.16, G7.4)
every label just outside its bar's end: neither the text grey nor white reads on the bar's colour at 4.5 : 1 (G7.4, G6.5)
the unit's description on its own line above the plot: “donations per donor”; the labels carry its prefix, suffix and magnitude

source.shows: a top 3 asked for as fractions: the all-parts check fails, readers taking the three for all donors, so a bar chart (R7-03, G0.13)
